notes.title: November 28, 2023 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1. We have fixed bugs that occur when restarting a stage or restarting the game.

2. We have addressed other bugs and improved convenience.

3. Next month, We plan to add additional stages, game BGM, and effect sounds in the future. Please be patient, and soon you'll be able to enjoy emotional BGM and ASMR-like sounds that can occur during repairs.

notes.title: November 21, 2023 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1. Now you can enjoy the game in Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, and German.

2. You can now skip the in-game dialogue to play quickly, but we encourage you to experience the full story without skipping.

3. We have made modifications to challenging and difficult puzzles to make the game more comfortable for you. Enjoy the game with a bit more ease.

4. Numerous bugs have been fixed. Thanks to those who reported bugs through reviews, discussions, and emails. We appreciate your feedback, and please continue to provide more in the future.

5. Next month, We plan to add additional stages, game BGM, and effect sounds in the future. Please be patient, and soon you'll be able to enjoy emotional BGM and ASMR-like sounds that can occur during repairs.
